payload.description_html: Fossilized tailbone of an Edmontosaurus at the Museum of the Rockies in Bozeman, Montana.  Note the impressions left by the skin in the rock (best seen between the upper and lower rows of darker bone), indicating that the skin was loose and lumpy on this specimen. (It is unclear where this fossil is from.)
